metadata.description: EvalHub agent skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: evalhub
plugins.description: Evaluate AI/ML models, run benchmarks, manage evaluation jobs, and follow EDD workflows

plugins.name: golang-toolchain-update
plugins.description: Scan a Go repository for vulnerabilities, determine the Go version needed to clear stdlib/toolchain findings (or the newest available patch), and update version pins in go.mod, container files, and CI only when the repository's go-toolset image publishes a matching tag (ubi9/ubi10)

plugins.name: evalhub-bug-review
plugins.description: Bug-focused review of an eval-hub pull request, branch, commit range, or working-tree change: returns a severity-ranked findings table with file:line locations and never edits code

plugins.name: fix-fvt-test
plugins.description: Diagnose a failing FVT (godog) scenario on an OpenShift AI cluster from the JUnit report, test log, and pod logs; produces a root-cause analysis and, when asked, a fix PR

plugins.name: release-notes
plugins.description: Draft OpenSSF-compliant, human-readable GitHub release notes for a tag or version, summarizing major changes and upgrade impact
